Alabama Crimson Tide.status: New starter — redshirt freshman promoted from within, replacing first-round pick Ty Simpson.
Alabama Crimson Tide.rushing: Not addressed in guide — but the guide expects Russell or Mack to add production on the ground that Simpson did not provide.
Alabama Crimson Tide.efficiency: Team-level only: Alabama finished 31st in EPA per play through the air and 21st in success rate on dropbacks in 2025.
Alabama Crimson Tide.competition: Open in name at least — the guide notes DeBoer will stage what it pointedly calls a “competition” in fall camp, while expecting Russell to start.
Alabama Crimson Tide.backup: Senior Austin Mack is the alternative named; the guide expects either Russell or Mack to be less efficient than Simpson.
Alabama Crimson Tide.author_confidence: Confident in the outcome, explicit about the condition. The guide treats DeBoer's record of developing quarterbacks as making Russell “a safe bet to be what people expect”, while framing the championship case as conditional on Russell winning the job and delivering.
Alabama Crimson Tide.positive_case: Russell is a young high-upside quarterback seen as ready to step in; his athleticism is a dimension Simpson lacked, and it is expected to help fix the run game.
Alabama Crimson Tide.concerns: The offense has to be rebuilt after heavy departures; the guide expects less efficiency than Simpson provided, and its doubts about the team sit on the offensive side.
Alabama Crimson Tide.scheme_fit: Explicitly good — Russell suits the RPO offense DeBoer and coordinator Ryan Grubb want to run.
Alabama Crimson Tide.supporting_cast: Poor and unproven up front: leading rusher Jam Miller (520 yards) is gone along with six offensive linemen who started games, leaving sophomore Michael Carroll the only returnee. The guide notes investment in the offensive line is expected to help.
Alabama Crimson Tide.betting_implications: Recommendation is Over 8.5 wins, and the guide states the case rests almost entirely on Russell. It also advises betting Alabama early — win total plus conference and national championship odds — arguing the team is flying under the radar.
Alabama Crimson Tide.outlook_dependency: Very high. The guide's Over and its national-title case are both stated as conditional on Russell winning the job and delivering.
Alabama Crimson Tide.conflicts: The guide expects Russell to start while simultaneously describing a fall-camp “competition”; both are stated, and neither is resolved in the guide.

Arkansas Razorbacks.status: New starter — sophomore promoted from within after limited 2025 duty.
Arkansas Razorbacks.career_experience: Sophomore; appeared in five games in 2025 and played extensively in the last two.
Arkansas Razorbacks.previous_starts: Not addressed in guide as a start count; the guide records five appearances with extensive work in the final two games.
Arkansas Razorbacks.passing: 27-of-46 (58.7%) for 332 yards and two touchdowns in 2025.
Arkansas Razorbacks.rushing: 41 rushing yards and one rushing touchdown.
Arkansas Razorbacks.efficiency: 58.7% completion rate; the guide adds that the left-hander showed pocket-passing touch in limited work.
Arkansas Razorbacks.competition: Nominally a battle with Memphis transfer AJ Hill, but the guide assumes Jackson starts against North Alabama in Week 1.
Arkansas Razorbacks.backup: AJ Hill, Memphis transfer, named as the challenger.
Arkansas Razorbacks.author_confidence: Moderate on identity, openly uncertain on quality. The guide assumes Jackson starts, then leaves “whether his upside arrives” explicitly open.
Arkansas Razorbacks.positive_case: Silverfield's offensive background should help Jackson develop and yield decent offensive production; the guide credits pocket-passing touch in limited work.
Arkansas Razorbacks.concerns: Upside is unproven, and the surrounding skill positions were stripped after the coaching change.
Arkansas Razorbacks.scheme_fit: Positive by implication — the guide cites head coach Ryan Silverfield's offensive background as the developmental asset.
Arkansas Razorbacks.supporting_cast: Weak. Arkansas lost its leading rusher and top three receivers. Braylen Russell (55 carries, 291 yards) is the top returning back, CJ Brown (28 receptions, 319 yards) the top returning receiver. Transfers Sutton Smith (Memphis), Jasper Parker (Michigan) and Jamari Hawkins (Memphis, 38 receptions, 623 yards) arrive; the pecking order is unknown.
Arkansas Razorbacks.portal_context: Hill, Smith and Hawkins all followed Silverfield from Memphis; Parker came from Michigan.
Arkansas Razorbacks.betting_implications: Recommendation is Under 4.5 wins. The quarterback is not the stated reason: the guide expects decent offensive production and blames the defense and the SEC schedule for sinking the season.
Arkansas Razorbacks.outlook_dependency: Low to moderate. The guide's Under is argued from defense and schedule, and it expects the quarterback to yield decent production regardless.

Auburn Tigers.status: Transfer — arrives from South Florida with head coach Alex Golesh.
Auburn Tigers.career_experience: Played for Golesh his entire career at USF.
Auburn Tigers.previous_starts: Not addressed in guide as a start count.
Auburn Tigers.passing: Completed 65.8% of his passes at USF; 4,238 combined passing and rushing yards with 42 total touchdowns.
Auburn Tigers.rushing: Included in the 4,238 combined passing and rushing yards and 42 total touchdowns; the guide does not split the rushing figure out.
Auburn Tigers.competition: None described — Brown is presented as the established starter.
Auburn Tigers.author_confidence: High. The guide rates Brown among the nation's best quarterbacks, calls him a legitimate Heisman threat, and notes he already has an SEC scalp, having beaten Florida in The Swamp.
Auburn Tigers.positive_case: One of the country's best quarterbacks arriving with the coach and system he has always played in, with familiar targets and an SEC win already on his record.
Auburn Tigers.concerns: The guide's caution is about level, not the player: last season's USF team is taking on an SEC schedule, which it says could be a Year 1 disaster.
Auburn Tigers.scheme_fit: Maximal continuity — Golesh brought essentially his whole South Florida offense, including coordinator Joel Gordon, who has worked under him for three years.
Auburn Tigers.supporting_cast: Strong and familiar: six USF receivers followed, including Jeremiah Koger (38 receptions, 597 yards) and Keshaun Singleton (50 receptions, 877 yards), with holdover running back Jeremiah Cobb expected to benefit from the scheme and Brown's presence.
Auburn Tigers.portal_context: Brown plus six USF receivers transferred in with the staff.
Auburn Tigers.betting_implications: Recommendation is Over 6.5 wins, with the guide arguing Golesh inherits close to an ideal situation built around one of the country's best quarterbacks. It also flags Brown as a legitimate Heisman threat.
Auburn Tigers.outlook_dependency: Very high. The turnaround case is stated to rest on Golesh and Brown, who were dominant together at South Florida.

Florida Gators.status: Transfer — from Georgia Tech; described as the most likely starter rather than a settled one.
Florida Gators.career_experience: Two years under offensive coordinator Buster Faulkner at Georgia Tech; a four-star transfer per 247.
Florida Gators.rushing: Not addressed in guide as production; the guide credits him with dual-threat ability.
Florida Gators.efficiency: Team-level only: Florida finished 116th in EPA per play through the air in 2025.
Florida Gators.turnovers: Team-level: Florida was -1 in turnover differential, and the guide makes ball security its stated priority for Philo.
Florida Gators.competition: Not settled in the guide's telling — Philo is “most likely”, with Tramell Jones having played two games in 2025 but not seen as Sumrall's choice.
Florida Gators.backup: Tramell Jones, who played two games in 2025.
Florida Gators.author_confidence: Low. The guide calls quarterback “a massive question” while noting there is nowhere to go but up.
Florida Gators.positive_case: Philo was recruited by Sumrall, already knows Faulkner's offense from two years at Georgia Tech, was a four-star transfer, and has dual-threat ability.
Florida Gators.concerns: Ball security is the guide's explicit priority, and the passing offense it inherits ranked 116th in EPA per play through the air.
Florida Gators.scheme_fit: Direct and pre-existing — Philo played under Faulkner at Georgia Tech for two years.
Florida Gators.portal_context: Philo transferred from Georgia Tech, recruited by Sumrall.
Florida Gators.betting_implications: Recommendation is Under 7.5 wins, argued from Sumrall's streak of conference title games having to end somewhere and from a schedule with almost no high-probability wins beyond FAU and Campbell.
Florida Gators.outlook_dependency: High as a stated question, moderate as a stated cause. The guide names quarterback a massive question but argues the Under from schedule and the difficulty of the SEC leap.

Georgia Bulldogs.career_experience: Not addressed in guide as a career summary; the guide treats him as the established 2025 starter.
Georgia Bulldogs.previous_starts: Not addressed in guide as a start count.
Georgia Bulldogs.passing: 2025 fourth quarters: 83.6% completions at 8.5 yards per attempt with nine touchdowns.
Georgia Bulldogs.efficiency: 83.6% fourth-quarter completions at 8.5 yards per attempt; Georgia's 79th-percentile late-down success rate, despite only 56th-percentile average third-down distance, is credited largely to him.
Georgia Bulldogs.competition: None described — Stockton is the settled starter.
Georgia Bulldogs.author_confidence: High. Stockton is named an early Heisman contender and the guide judges 20-1 a defensible price.
Georgia Bulldogs.positive_case: Highly clutch in 2025, working behind a retooled line and a deep running back group, with a 20th-ranked schedule the guide says gives him a platform to build a Heisman resume.
Georgia Bulldogs.concerns: He returns just one of his top five receivers, and the guide calls Georgia's reliance on him to rescue long third downs unsustainable.
Georgia Bulldogs.supporting_cast: Three offensive line starters return including Fourth Team All-American center Drew Bobo, and the top three rushers behind Stockton are back, with Nate Frazier (958 yards, 5.5 per carry) projected to pass 1,000. The line is projected to start two sophomores and a freshman alongside Bobo.
Georgia Bulldogs.betting_implications: Recommendation is Over 9.5 wins, with the guide openly noting the pricing makes the best wager hard to isolate — Over 9.5 lays 180, Under 10.5 lays 190. It also rates Stockton's 20-1 Heisman price defensible.
Georgia Bulldogs.outlook_dependency: High. The guide credits Georgia's late-down success largely to Stockton and calls the offense's reliance on him unsustainable, which makes his play the stated hinge on an otherwise loaded team.

Kentucky Wildcats.career_experience: Former four-star recruit; at Notre Dame he genuinely pushed CJ Carr in camp. Flipped from a Nebraska commitment in a single day.
Kentucky Wildcats.previous_starts: Not addressed in guide as a start count; the guide describes spot duty.
Kentucky Wildcats.passing: 20 of 26 for 196 yards in spot duty.
Kentucky Wildcats.efficiency: 20 of 26 (the guide does not state a percentage).
Kentucky Wildcats.competition: None described — Minchey is presented as the incoming starter.
Kentucky Wildcats.author_confidence: High on fit, explicitly untested on delivery. The guide rates the Minchey-Stein pairing very highly while listing as an open unknown whether Stein can keep developing quarterbacks while carrying head-coaching duties.
Kentucky Wildcats.positive_case: A former four-star who pushed CJ Carr at Notre Dame, paired with a coach who developed quarterbacks at Oregon.
Kentucky Wildcats.concerns: The guide's doubts attach to the coach rather than the player: whether Stein can develop quarterbacks as a head coach, and whether he can run an efficient SEC offense with less talent than at Oregon.
Kentucky Wildcats.scheme_fit: Rated very highly — Stein developed Bo Nix, Dillon Gabriel and Dante Moore at Oregon and called plays for an offense that never finished below 13th nationally in scoring.
Kentucky Wildcats.supporting_cast: Stein imported decent skill-position talent; the guide does not name the players.
Kentucky Wildcats.portal_context: Minchey arrived from Notre Dame after flipping from a Nebraska commitment in a single day, with the guide gesturing at NIL as the likely mechanism.
Kentucky Wildcats.betting_implications: Recommendation is Over 4.5 wins, framed explicitly as a statement of belief in Stein's offensive ability, with Minchey expected to benefit. The Over also depends on coordinator Jay Bateman getting the defense to repeat its 2025 production.
Kentucky Wildcats.outlook_dependency: High. The Over is argued from the quarterback-and-coach pairing, though the guide splits the dependency with the defense.

LSU Tigers.career_experience: 20 games at Arizona State; led the Sun Devils to the 2024 playoff. Top-ranked transfer quarterback per 247.
LSU Tigers.previous_starts: Not addressed in guide as a start count; the guide records 20 games.
LSU Tigers.passing: Completed 61.3% over 20 games at Arizona State with 34 touchdowns against nine interceptions.
LSU Tigers.turnovers: Nine interceptions against 34 touchdowns across 20 games.
LSU Tigers.competition: None described — Leavitt is the presumptive starter.
LSU Tigers.author_confidence: High on talent, explicitly guarded on availability and timing. Landing Leavitt is rated a win comparable to hiring Kiffin, but the guide warns of a possible slow start.
LSU Tigers.positive_case: The top-ranked transfer quarterback in the country, with playoff experience and a strong two-year statistical record.
LSU Tigers.concerns: A Lisfranc injury ended his 2025 season and cost him spring practice; Kiffin told ESPN his concern was Leavitt's transition into the offense rather than his health. With only fall camp for reps, the guide warns of a possible slow start.
LSU Tigers.scheme_fit: Flagged as the risk — Kiffin's stated concern is the transition into the offense.
LSU Tigers.supporting_cast: Entire position groups are being rebuilt around him, including nine receiver transfers; five-star offensive tackle Jordan Seaton arrived.
LSU Tigers.portal_context: Kiffin took 41 portal commits, sixth-most nationally; per Phil Steele the class brought 107 career starts. Leavitt is its headline addition.
LSU Tigers.betting_implications: Recommendation is Under 8.5 wins. The guide names a quarterback returning from a serious foot injury as one of two explicit reasons for caution alongside the schedule, and tells bettors to monitor how effective Leavitt is coming off that injury.
LSU Tigers.outlook_dependency: High. The guide makes Leavitt's health and scheme transition an explicit input to its Under recommendation and a stated in-season monitoring item.

Mississippi State Bulldogs.status: New starter — former four-star promoted from within after starting the final two games of 2025.
Mississippi State Bulldogs.career_experience: Former four-star recruit; appeared in several games in 2025 and started the last two.
Mississippi State Bulldogs.previous_starts: Two — the final two games of 2025, against Ole Miss and Wake Forest.
Mississippi State Bulldogs.passing: 28 of 53 for 419 yards with a touchdown and an interception across those two starts.
Mississippi State Bulldogs.rushing: 264 rushing yards and three rushing touchdowns.
Mississippi State Bulldogs.efficiency: 28 of 53 (the guide does not state a percentage).
Mississippi State Bulldogs.turnovers: One interception against one passing touchdown in the two-start sample.
Mississippi State Bulldogs.competition: None described — Taylor is presented as taking over.
Mississippi State Bulldogs.author_confidence: Positive and specific. The guide rates him a true dual threat with explosive running ability and says hype has built for years and peaked late in 2025.
Mississippi State Bulldogs.positive_case: Explosive running ability is a dimension Blake Shapen did not offer, and the guide expects that to unlock more for Lebby's offense.
Mississippi State Bulldogs.concerns: Not addressed in guide as a quarterback concern; the guide's doubts are about the defense and Lebby's 1-15 SEC record.
Mississippi State Bulldogs.scheme_fit: Explicitly good — the bull case is Lebby building an offense around Taylor's explosiveness.
Mississippi State Bulldogs.supporting_cast: Fluff Bothwell returns after 677 yards at 4.8 per carry, with ten of his 17 explosive runs in the first five weeks at 5.9 yards per carry and 3.75 after contact; paired with Taylor the guide rates him a strong bet for 1,000 yards.
Mississippi State Bulldogs.betting_implications: Recommendation is Over 4.5 wins. The bull case rests on Taylor's running ability and Lebby building around that explosiveness, though the arithmetic the guide lays out also needs the defense to improve on 30.4 points allowed per game.
Mississippi State Bulldogs.outlook_dependency: High. The guide states the bull case rests on Taylor's running ability, though it splits the requirement with defensive improvement.
